name: Prescription Medicine
description: Guidelines for traveling with prescription medicine in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Prescription pills and capsules are allowed in carry-on. Medical liquids, gels, and aerosols are exempt from the 3-1-1 rule in reasonable quantities but must be declared for inspection.

checkedBag.reason: Prescription medicines are allowed in checked baggage, though carrying critical medication in the cabin is strongly recommended.

faq.question: Is prescription medicine allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Prescription Medicine is allowed in carry-on luggage. Prescription pills and capsules are allowed in carry-on. Medical liquids, gels, and aerosols are exempt from the 3-1-1 rule in reasonable quantities but must be declared for inspection.

faq.question: Can you pack prescription medicine in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Prescription Medicine is allowed in checked bags. Prescription medicines are allowed in checked baggage, though carrying critical medication in the cabin is strongly recommended.
